# Nikita Mukhortov — Product Design Portfolio

Canonical site: https://niplusm.github.io/nplusm/

Nikita Mukhortov is a Product Design Lead in Amsterdam working across AI and agentic products, developer tools, fintech and payments, blockchain and Web3, marketplaces, B2B and enterprise software, consumer health, and telecom.

## Primary pages

- Portfolio and selected work: https://niplusm.github.io/nplusm/

- Scientific publication: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01969
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/nik-mukhortov-5199351ab/
